triggers.name: new_post_v2
triggers.title: New post (v2)
triggers.description: New post created on WordPress (REST v2)
triggers.help: Checks for new events every {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes.

input.name: ___poll_interval
input.label: Trigger poll interval
input.hint: How frequently to check for new events. Defaults to {{authUser.membership.poll_interval}} minutes if left blank. Minimum value allowed is {{authUser.membership.min_poll_interval}} minutes. Learn more …

input.name: post_type
input.label: Post type
input.hint: Filter to a single post type. Defaults to post .

input.name: since
input.label: When first started, this recipe should pick up events from
input.hint: When you start the recipe for the first time, it picks up posts created after this date/time. Leave empty to pick up posts from one hour ago. Once recipe has been run or tested, value cannot be change…

actions.name: __adhoc_http_action

actions.help: Build your own Wordpress action with a HTTP request. The request will be authorized under your Wordpress connection OAuth scopes: Scopes user:read, post:read, post:write, post_comment:read, post_comment:write, site_tag:read, site_tag:write, users_notification:read, users_notification:write, stats_si…

input.label: Action name
input.hint: Give this action you're building a descriptive name, e.g. create record, get record

input.name: verb
input.label: Method
input.hint: Select HTTP method of the request

actions.title: Reply to comment
actions.help: Creates a reply as a child of an existing comment. The reply's moderation status is determined by site discussion settings (may default to hold ).

input.label: Parent comment ID
input.hint: ID of the comment this reply is attached to.

input.name: post
input.label: Post ID

input.label: Content
input.hint: Reply body. May contain HTML.

actions.name: trash_comment
actions.title: Trash comment
actions.description: Move comment to trash in WordPress
actions.help: Moves the comment to trash. Trashed comments remain in WordPress until permanently removed via admin and are excluded from standard listings.

actions.name: trash_page
actions.title: Trash page
actions.description: Move page to trash in WordPress
actions.help: Moves the page to trash. Trashed items are retained for ~30 days. Note: child pages are not automatically trashed and become orphaned (parent=0).

actions.name: trash_post
actions.title: Trash post
actions.description: Move post to trash in WordPress
actions.help: Moves the post to trash. Trashed items are retained for ~30 days and can be restored via the WordPress admin. The connector does not permanently delete content.

input.name: post_type
input.label: Post type
input.hint: Select the post type the record to trash belongs to.
